lines.text: Wait for you, not wait you!
Many learners say: I will wait you here.
Better: I will wait for you here.

data.right: I will wait for you here.

native.hook: 等人别漏了 for 哦！
native.tip: 中文“等你”可以直接说，动词后面就是人。英语的 wait 后面不能直接接人，要加 for。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I will wait you here.”😅 中文“等你”直接接人，英语要加 for：“I will wait for you here.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I will wait for you here.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: In Chinese, wait is followed by the person, but English needs for after wait.
en.caption: Do you say “I will wait you here.” 😅 English needs for after wait: “I will wait for you here.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
